32 Bit in front of the Struct. ⌋
[TR_SOMEIP_00080] ⌈If the length of the length ﬁeld is not speciﬁed, a length of 0
has to be assumed and no length ﬁeld is in the message. ⌋
[TR_SOMEIP_00081] ⌈The length ﬁeld of the struct describes the number of bytes of
the struct. If the length is greater than the length of the struct as speciﬁed in the Inter-
face Deﬁnition only the bytes speciﬁed in the Interface Speciﬁcation shall be interpreted
and the other bytes shall be skipped based on the length ﬁeld.
This allows for extensible structs which allow better migration of interfaces. ⌋
